mapper.select: SELECT file_meta_id, tenant_id, file_name, file_suffix, file_store_path, file_md5, file_size, create_time, deleted FROM file_meta WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_md5 = #{fileMd5} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT file_meta_id, tenant_id, file_name, file_suffix, file_store_path, file_md5, file_size, create_time, deleted FROM file_meta WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_md5 = #{fileMd5} ORDER BY deleted ASC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE file_meta SET deleted = 0, file_name = #{fileName}, file_suffix = #{fileSuffix}, file_store_path = #{fileStorePath}, file_size = #{fileSize}, create_time = NOW() WHERE file_meta_id = #{fileMetaId} AND deleted = 1
